verdict.description: One factual sentence. Example: Plan matches the PR intent; Helm diff only bumps the image tag.

status.description: clean: everything reviewed, nothing to raise. findings: at least one finding. incomplete: a source that should exist was missing or unreadable.

summary_markdown.description: Optional free-form Markdown rendered above the findings. Use it for a structured review summary when a skill produces one (author relationship, ticket linkage, approval chain, recommendation). Leave empty for plan and Helm reviews.

references.description: Resource addresses, file paths, stack or project names, quoted plan or diff lines.

apply_readiness.description: Short factual statements about whether the change is ready to apply: plans present for every touched project, lock contention, stale plan, autodeploy on merge, failing checks.
